references.text: The prophecy of the Lord's entry into Jerusalem on a donkey, which predicts the event described in Mark 11:7.
The prediction that the king comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, fulfilled in Mark 11:7.
Matthew's description of Jesus' entry into Jerusalem, paralleling the event in Mark 11:7.
Luke's account of Jesus' entry into Jerusalem, which resembles Mark 11:7.
John's description of how Jesus found a donkey and sat on it, consistent with what is described in Mark 11:7.
